subject: Energy
title: Mining and Energy Materials
description: A 60-second lesson on Mining and Energy Materials.

hook.text: Clean energy isn't mining-free—lithium, cobalt, copper, and rare earths are essential for batteries and turbines.

buildup.text: Cobalt mining in the DRC involves dangerous artisanal mines—including child labor in some operations.

discovery.text: An EV battery requires about 8 kg of lithium, 14 kg of cobalt, and 20 kg of nickel—substantial mineral demand.

twist.text: Fossil fuels also require massive mining—coal mining alone moves more earth annually than all metal mining combined.

climax.text: Responsible sourcing and recycling can reduce mining's harm—but the transition needs honest material analysis.

punchline.text: No free lunch—clean energy trades fuel mining for mineral mining.

quiz.question: Which country is a major source of cobalt for batteries?
